title: Prevent an alternate directory with the same ordinary test run ID from displacing the original
outcome: Ordinary test-run discovery preserves the canonical original identity when another scanned directory presents the same run ID.
acceptance: A real ordinary run plus a same-ID copy in another scanned review-runs directory leaves the original live or retained identity authoritative across refresh and restart.
When original files are unavailable, the history and detail show the original run's bounded unavailable state and never attribute the copy's diagnostics or outcome to it.
